impact_scope.description: S1 adds a public LZMA decoder implementing base.io_transformer, with transform_io as the caller-facing decoding entry and decode_bitstream_slow as its private decoding implementation.
S1 newly accepts and parses LZMA headers and compressed bitstreams through caller-supplied source and destination buffers.
Exercising the new LZMA entry requires compiling the LZMA module, while H0 explicitly compiles only AUX BASE, AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON modules.

evidence: S0 has no matching LZMA decoder declaration or production implementation in the fixed scope.
Because the LZMA entry and input format do not exist in S0, H0 has no S0 obligation to enable or invoke them.

gap_after.type: missing exposure of new public decoder and input format
evidence: S1 introduces public decoder.transform_io(dst, src, workbuf), which exposes LZMA decoding through caller-supplied I/O buffers.
H0 enables only JSON-related modules and invokes only JSON decoding paths; it neither enables the LZMA module nor constructs and calls the new LZMA decoder.
Consequently, H0 cannot feed fuzz-controlled LZMA headers and bitstreams through decoder.transform_io in S1.

new_harness_obligation.description: The harness must enable the new LZMA production module, initialize its decoder, construct fuzz-controlled source and destination buffers, and call decoder.transform_io so the new LZMA format and decoding path are reachable.
evidence: decoder is newly public in S1 and implements base.io_transformer.
decoder.transform_io newly requires dst, src, and workbuf arguments and drives decode_properties followed by decode_bitstream_slow.
H0's compile-time module list contains no LZMA enablement and its fuzz entry only dispatches to JSON decoding.

reason: Within the stable scope of the newly added LZMA decoder, S0 has no corresponding capability and therefore no harness gap, whereas S1 adds a public decoder, a new compressed-input format, and caller-controlled I/O interactions that unchanged H0 cannot reach. This creates a concrete new harness obligation, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
